row.notes: (self, car) where car[0] = vehicle index, car+0x28 lap state (int laps +0x20, frac +0x10, +0x140/+0x144 floats), car+0x38 resource data (+8 amount, +0xc factor, +0x10 reserve*5, +0x18/+0x1c/+0x20 three per-lap rates, +0x3c speed). If [car+0x28]+0x140 > 2.0 stores lap progress to self+0xc. Computes three budget ratios ratio_i = clamp(amount*factor - 5*reserve) / (self+0x10 * rate_i * (self+8 laps - progress)) into self+0x14, +0x18, +0x1c. Then selects a mode 0..3 written to self+0x28 and *[car+0x48]: forced from [car+0x30]+0xb4 when [car+0x30]+0xb8 set, or from a component vcall when [car+0x50]+0x18 bit 0x1000, else from ratio thresholds (1.0/1.05/1.2/1.4) via 0x1405fb2f0; the mode is always snapped to an allowed one using the per-car table [[self]+0x50]+car*0x20+0x28..+0x34 (4 ints). (corrected 2026-11-14: outputs are ratios at +0x14/+0x18/+0x1c and a 0..3 mode, not "targets at +0xc, +0x14 and following".)
